HCHS::confirmed::HCHS-ingest/chr_bronchi.notes:
Both HP:0004469 or OMOP:256451 can be used to map chronic bronchitis. http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0004469 or https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/256451
The deciding factor is the BDCHM slot type.  
  Use MONDO:0005607  -   Note on "doctor stated"
  The variable description "doctor stated" signals physician-diagnosed chronic bronchitis — not a symptom report. HCHS::confirmed::afib.yaml.notes:
Atrial fibrillation" — that's the standard concept; the ICD-9 427.31, ICD-10-CM I48.91, MeSH, and MedDRA codes are non-standard source concepts (the standard concept_id is 313217)
Both phv00226270 (ECG-derived) and phv00526613 (self-reported) are the same condition — atrial fibrillation — so MONDO:0004981 applies to both; the ECG-vs-self-report difference is provenance, not a different concept.
